planning.decision_rule: first day of each local calendar month

population.interpretation: synthetic unweighted activity sample; not a measured Toronto pedestrian count

day_clock.time_representation: integer elapsed seconds from local calendar midnight
day_clock.local_day_length: derive from consecutive local midnights; may be 23, 24, or 25 elapsed hours
day_clock.browser_playback: presentation only; cannot change event ordering

funding.scenario_balance_status: user-selected FY2026 planning input; not yet executable by the day runner
funding.source_restriction: program restrictions and reserve apply; not general-purpose infrastructure funding
funding.future_year_appropriations: unspecified; do not repeat or roll forward automatically
funding.annual_ledger_gate: must be implemented before the planner can commit against this balance

model.random_generator: Python random.Random with the manifest seed
model.event_order: integer simulation second, core phase, seeded stable tie rank, insertion index

known_unknowns: verified pedestrian expansion weights and target population
Toronto statutory holiday, school, and seasonal operating calendars
household income and benefit dates, non-food obligations, and recurring activity schedules
site staffing, capacity, inventory replenishment, costs, and eligibility
future fiscal-year appropriations, eligible uses, reserves, and rollover authority
